# Open Antigravity
> Portable, selective routing proxy and environment manager for Google Antigravity in Rust.

## Core Directives
- Standard: Q.E.D. High-Assurance Engineering Standard (Mode A: Quality > Speed).
- Evidence Before Assertions: Terminal verification required for all tasks.
- Architecture: Zero-C-dependency Rust codebase (GUI via eframe/egui, TUI via ratatui, network proxy, patcher).
- Primary Entrypoint: `src/main.rs`.

## Key Files & Modules
- [AI README](AI_README.md): Full machine instructions, CLI flags, invariants, and architecture topology.
- [Human README](README.md): User guide, quickstart, and downloads.
- [Proxy Setup Guide](PROXY_SETUP.md): Custom upstream proxy configurations.
- [Portable Build Guide](BUILD_PORTABLE.md): Portable binary packaging specifications.
- [Network Subsystem](src/network/mod.rs): DNS forwarder, DoH, selective proxy engine, resolvers.
- [Core Logic](src/core/mod.rs): Settings, portable data paths, updater, background operations.
- [Patcher Engine](src/patcher/mod.rs): ASAR unpacking, binary hex patching, file watchdog.
- [Platform Bindings](src/platform/mod.rs): Windows NRPT, scheduled tasks, UAC elevation, Linux/SteamOS support.
- [GUI Views](src/gui/mod.rs): Immediate mode desktop UI.
- [TUI View](src/tui/mod.rs): Terminal UI for headless and SSH setups.
